name: Hattil
title: Descendant of Solomon's Servants
summary: Hattil is mentioned as the ancestor of one of the families among the descendants of Solomon's servants who returned from exile in Babylon to Jerusalem. He is only named in the lists of returning exiles in Ezra and Nehemiah, and little is known about his personal life beyond his connection to temple service.

keyEvents.title: Listed Among the Descendants of Solomon's Servants in Ezra's List
keyEvents.description: Hattil is mentioned among the descendants of Solomon's servants who returned from Babylon to Judah under Zerubbabel's leadership.

keyEvents.title: Listed Among the Descendants of Solomon's Servants in Nehemiah's List
keyEvents.description: In Nehemiah's parallel list of returning exiles, Hattil's descendants are again mentioned among the descendants of Solomon's servants.

keyEvents.title: The Return from Babylon
keyEvents.description: Hattil's descendants were part of the large group that traveled back from the Babylonian exile to rebuild Jerusalem and the temple.

keyEvents.title: Restoration of Temple Service
keyEvents.description: As descendants of Solomon's servants, Hattil's family had a role in restoring temple service in Jerusalem after returning from exile.
